ui.description: Multi-client UI layer: Angular 19 (customer UI), Blazor Server (client app), Blazor Server (admin app)

required_patterns.angular-components: Standalone Angular components using @Component decorator with templateUrl/styleUrl; import Angular Material modules directly in the component's imports array
required_patterns.blazor-pages: Razor pages with @page directive, @inject ApiClient for data access, OnInitializedAsync lifecycle hook for data loading
required_patterns.blazor-layout: MainLayout.razor wraps all pages; NavMenu.razor provides navigation sidebar

architectural_constraints.angular-components: Components are standalone (no NgModules); Angular Material is used for UI primitives
architectural_constraints.blazor-pages: Pages fetch data exclusively via injected ApiClient; no direct EF Core or repository injection in pages
architectural_constraints.data-binding: Blazor pages use null-check pattern (@if (rooms == null)) with Loading... placeholder before data is available

routing.description: Angular router for the Angular UI; Blazor file-based routing (@page directive) for Blazor Client and Admin

required_patterns.angular-routing: Routes defined in app.routes.ts as a Routes array; components referenced directly (no lazy loading in current codebase)
required_patterns.blazor-routing: Each page declares its route via @page "/path" directive at the top of the .razor file

architectural_constraints.angular-routing: Route definitions live exclusively in app.routes.ts; navigation links use RouterLink directive
architectural_constraints.blazor-routing: Blazor router is configured in Routes.razor / App.razor; routes map 1:1 to .razor page files

data-layer.description: EF Core with SQL Server accessed exclusively through the generic IRepository<T> / Repository<T> pattern in the API

required_patterns.repository-pattern: All entity CRUD goes through IRepository<T>; controllers receive IRepository<T> via constructor injection
required_patterns.db-context: HotelDbContext extends IdentityDbContext<User, Role, int>; all entities configured via OnModelCreating with unique index constraints and seed data
required_patterns.dto-mapping: AutoMapper MappingProfile registers bidirectional maps for every entity ↔ DTO pair; DTOs are flat (no nested navigation objects)

architectural_constraints.repository-pattern: No direct DbContext or DbSet usage outside Repository<T>; no raw SQL in controllers
architectural_constraints.dtos: DTOs must include denormalized string fields (e.g., RoomNumber, UserName) instead of nested entity references to avoid circular serialization
architectural_constraints.automapper: All new entity/DTO pairs must be registered in MappingProfile.cs

auth.description: ASP.NET Core Identity for user/role management; JWT Bearer tokens for stateless API authentication; role-based and claim-based authorization policies

required_patterns.jwt-generation: JWT tokens are generated inside AccountController.GenerateJwtToken; includes user claims, role claims (fetched from RoleManager), and role membership claims
required_patterns.authorization: Controllers use [Authorize(Roles = "Administrator")] and/or [Authorize(Policy = "...")] attributes; AccountController is [AllowAnonymous]
required_patterns.identity-config: Identity options (password strength, lockout) configured in Program.cs via Configure<IdentityOptions>

architectural_constraints.jwt: Tokens expire in 30 minutes; signing uses HmacSha256 with a SecretKey from appsettings JwtSettings section
architectural_constraints.registration: New users are always assigned the 'Customer' role and a 'Department:Sales' claim on registration
architectural_constraints.roles: Three seeded roles: Administrator, Guest, Customer — defined in HotelDbContext seed data

api-layer.description: ASP.NET Core Web API providing RESTful endpoints consumed by Blazor and Angular clients via HttpClient-based ApiClient

required_patterns.controller-structure: Controllers use primary constructor injection; inherit ControllerBase; decorated with [Route("api/[controller]")] and [ApiController]
required_patterns.api-client: Both Blazor projects use an identical ApiClient class (HttpClient + IConfiguration) with generic GetAsync<T>, PostAsync<T>, PutAsync<T>, DeleteAsync methods; base URL from appsettings ApiBaseUrl

architectural_constraints.controller-responses: GET returns Ok(entity/list), POST returns CreatedAtAction, PUT returns NoContent, DELETE returns NoContent, not-found returns NotFound()
architectural_constraints.api-client: All HTTP calls from Blazor/Angular go through ApiClient; no direct HttpClient usage in pages/components
architectural_constraints.swagger: API is documented with Swagger; JWT Bearer security definition is always included

shared-library.description: HotelManagementSystem.Shared is the cross-cutting class library referenced by all other projects; contains models, DTOs, enums, interfaces, repositories, DB context, migrations, and utilities

required_patterns.models: Entity models are plain C# classes with int Id primary key; relationships expressed via navigation properties and foreign key int properties
required_patterns.enums: Status enums (BookingStatus, PaymentStatus) are defined in Enums/ and referenced in models and DTOs
required_patterns.utilities: Static utility classes (e.g., PasswordHasher) placed in Utilities/

architectural_constraints.shared-references: All projects reference HotelManagementSystem.Shared; no duplication of models or DTOs across projects
architectural_constraints.migrations: EF Core migrations live in HotelManagementSystem.Shared/Migrations/
